evidence: Morris (2009), introduction, defines graph r-neighbor bootstrap but the results concern square grids.
Gerbner et al. (2016), full introductory definition: r line percolation fills every point of a line once r points are active; the authors explicitly set aside r=1,2 as elementary.
The present model activates line vertices from two active point vertices and point vertices from two active line vertices; it does not fill all points on a line at once.

A 42-vertex classical incidence geometry has six natural minimum-seed shore compositions and exactly three distinct completion rounds, quantified over all 334656 optima.
